meta.description: Architecture patterns and data flows for Claude Code Sidekick

overview.type: Monorepo - Claude Code development framework + CLI + multi-model AI toolkit + SvelteKit dashboard

cli.description: npx create-claude-project CLI for project scaffolding

tools/multi-model.description: Multi-model AI toolkit (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Venice)

tools/dashboard.description: SvelteKit local web dashboard for project management

specDrivenDevelopment.description: EARS notation requirements → project-plan → tasks → implementation
specDrivenDevelopment.phaseGate: HARD STOP between phases - user must explicitly advance

agentSystem.description: Specialized agents in .claude/agents/ for domain-specific tasks

skillSystem.purpose: Enforce development discipline and phase boundaries

venice.description: Uncensored models with private inference (VVV token ecosystem)

singleModelMode.description: Falls back gracefully when only one API key is present
singleModelMode.primaryProviderLogic: First provider in [openai, anthropic, gemini, venice] order

modelRouting.strategy: Task-type based routing to optimal model

dashboardArchitecture.launchMechanism: Auto-launched by CLI after scaffolding (non-blocking spawn)
dashboardArchitecture.security: No auth required - Tailscale network is security boundary. All API calls proxied server-side.

dataFlows.cliScaffold: User runs npx create-claude-project -> CLI prompts -> scaffoldProject() -> copies templates -> installs deps -> launchDashboard() (non-blocking) -> opens browser
dataFlows.multiModelReview: Code input -> code-review.js -> parallel requests to all available providers -> consensus aggregation -> formatReviewResults()
dataFlows.semanticSearch: indexCodebase() -> embedBatch() via OpenAI -> JSON index file -> searchCodebase() -> cosine similarity -> ranked results
dataFlows.phasedDevelopment: EARS spec -> /project-planner -> phase plans -> /task-planner -> task files -> /task-runner -> agent execution -> HARD STOP

configFiles..claude/config.yml: Main agent system config (agents, commands, hooks, rules, planning)
configFiles..env.example: All env vars documented with instructions
